title: Generalized (v,w)-core inverse in Banach *-algebras
content: In this paper, we introduce the generalized (v,w)-core inverse in a Banach *-algebra. We characterize this new generalized inverse by using the generalized weighted core decomposition and present the representations by the weighted g-Drazin inverse. These extend the weighted core inverse and weighted core-EP inverse for complex matrices and linear bounded operators to more general setting.
